name: organization-ai-skills
description: Generic Agent Skills for organizational knowledge work, for Claude and ChatGPT. Grouped into installable plugins so admins can preinstall some for everyone and offer others per team.

plugins.name: org-research
plugins.description: Cited web research, per-job search and fetch tool routing, LinkedIn and Reddit scraping, and prospect qualification that stays read-only against your CRM.

plugins.name: org-agents
plugins.description: Subagent delegation and a war-council decision panel, with five ready worker agents. Routes gathering, reading, and bulk work to cheaper models and escalates only when it helps.

plugins.name: org-content
plugins.description: Content and comms drafting (blog, social, press, case studies, email, events, strategy), audience personas, personal voice, and a factual-accuracy gate with a claim scanner.

plugins.name: org-meetings
plugins.description: Daily and weekly triage, prep for a specific meeting, meeting write-ups, Slack summaries, and a ledger that tracks what you promised across meetings over time.

plugins.name: org-ops
plugins.description: Asana tasks, document search and storage, launch planning, Zapier workflows, Obsidian vault setup, and the path for staff to propose a fix to a skill.
